rows.name: τ³-Voice — Overall (Multilingual)
rows.focus: Real-time, full-duplex voice agents on retail, airline, and telecom customer-service tasks (published as τ-voice); Overall covers the three core domains.
rows.metrics_detail:
Quality [page]: Task completion — pass@1 (%) over the frame, each language-domain cell weighted equally; Overall = Airline, Retail, Telecom · https://github.com/sierra-research/tau2-bench/blob/main/web/leaderboard/src/components/MultilingualVoice.jsx
Breakdown [page]: Language map — per-language scores (en, es, pt, hi, zh, ...) per metric; click-a-score breakdown; by_language / by_domain in data · https://github.com/sierra-research/tau2-bench/blob/main/web/leaderboard/src/components/Multilingual
rows.notes: JS page; default voice view on /leaderboard is the Multilingual edition, values from https://taubench.com/voice-leaderboard.json (snapshot the page loads) computed with the site's voiceV2Rows.js; Standard-only default filter (no custom multilingual rows exist). Task completion = pass@1 over all languages (en, es, pt, hi, ko, zh cells). Also shows Interaction and Generation quality columns.
rows.difficulty_detail:

rows.name: τ^τ-bench (hyper-tau-bench)
rows.focus: Coding harnesses (harness + builder model) building customer-service agents; Overall = mean over all 53 tasks (airline 6, retail 6, telecom 6, banking 35).
rows.metrics: quality, cost, time, effort, date, breakdown, other
rows.metrics_detail:
Quality [page]: Overall — mean score (%) over all 53 tasks of the agent built by harness + builder model (e.g. 52.2%; human 82.2%) · https://sierra-research.github.io/hyper-tau-bench/
Cost [page]: Build cost — '$X / task' USD to build the agent, in the expanded row (build_cost_usd) · https://github.com/sierra-research/hyper-tau-bench/blob/main/web/leaderboard/src/components/HyperTau.jsx
Time [page]: Build time — 'X min / task' (build_time_min), in the expanded row · https://github.com/sierra-res
rows.notes: Separate sibling site linked from taubench.com's Leaderboards menu (not a τ²/τ³ domain). JS page; Overall scores from hyper-submissions/*/submission.json, matching the prerendered table. Harnesses: Google Arc (high), Claude Code (max), Codex (xhigh). Human performance shown as 82.2%. Board version 'release-v1 · 53 tasks'.
